# Heliograph antenna build

Ordered the CANARY-XK42 phased array kit from the co-op. The mounting bracket
needs a 7/16" spade bit, which the garage set does not have.

Key decision: mount on the east gable, not the chimney, because the chimney
flashing is original and the roofer said not to disturb it.

Next steps:
- Pick up spade bit
- Ground rod placement sketch
- Check HOA line-of-sight rules
